en: The Section on Further Exposition, Part Six:
The Convergence of the Modes of Conveying:
The Fourfold Array. Herein, what is the convergence of the modes of conveying as the fourfold array?
It is the verse beginning: “Therefore, for one whose mind is guarded, the range of right intention.”
“*Tasmā rakkhitacittassā*”: the etymological derivation (*nirutti*) is that the guarded mind is protected (*paripāliyati*).
What is the Blessed One’s intention here?
His intention here is this: those who wish to be liberated from miserable rebirths will become practitioners of the Dhamma.
For Kokālika, having harbored malice toward the elder monks Sāriputta and Moggallāna, was reborn in the Mahāpaduma hell.
And the Blessed One is endowed with a mind protected by mindfulness; as it is said in the Sutta:
"The mind must be guarded by means of mindfulness."
The fourfold application of the modes of convergence is concluded.
